note: Main camping area of Cross Timbers State Park on Toronto Lake's north shore: the Osage Plains, Timber Ridge, Clovis Point and East Ramp utility loops, the Sandstone and Chautauqua Hills primitive areas, and four modern cabins. Boat ramp; 15 miles of hiking and biking trails round the lake. --Claude
